newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity options volume posts record in July.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity options volume posts record in July.

text.p: U.S. equity options volume continued to surge in July, when volume rose to a record 26,901,636 contracts, up 57 percent over the 17,131,421 contracts that changed hands in July 1996, the Options Industry Council (OIC) said Wednesday.
The prior record was 23,001,365 contracts set in January.
The OIC said average daily volume in July was 1,222,802 contracts compared with 778,701 in July 1996.
It said year-to-date volume through July totaled 152,402,091 contracts, a 31 percent increase over the 116,331,990 contracts traded in the first six months of 1996.
